programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Anaheim Ducks host the Edmonton Oilers at Honda Center in a Pacific Division NHL matchup. Anaheim enters after a 4-3 win led by Leo Carlsson's two-point night, while Edmonton counters after Connor McDavid scored in a 3-1 victory on Oct. 3.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Washington Capitals host the Pittsburgh Penguins at Capital One Arena in NHL action. Washington looks to bounce back after Boone Jenner notched an assist on Oct. 3, while Pittsburgh enters following Evgeni Malkin's three-point game on Oct. 3.
